description.zh:
审核任务配置信息。
- 审核任务其他配置项，当前仅支持ResourceType字段，用于控制媒体文件类型，且可针对该类型调整审核标准和规则。
- ResourceType使用说明：只允许英文、数字、下划线。

>- ResourceType字段可以按照使用说明自定义。自定义后需要[填写宜搭信息](https://yida.alibaba-inc.com/o/ticketapply)提交到阿里云后台处理后才会生效。
>- 如需针对ResourceType调整审核标准和规则，您可以[填写宜搭信息](https://yida.alibaba-inc.com/o/ticketapply)申请技术支持。
description.en:
The configuration of the moderation job.

- Use this field to specify the type of the media file and adjust moderation rules for that type.

- The value of ResourceType can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

> * You can customize the value of ResourceType. After customization, you must [fill out the Yida form](https://yida.alibaba-inc.com/o/ticketapply) and submit it to Alibaba Cloud. The custom value takes effect after Alibaba Cloud processes your submission.
>
> * To adjust the moderation criteria and rules for a specific ResourceType, you can [fill out the Yida form](https://yida.alibaba-inc.com/o/ticketapply) to request technical support.

description.zh:
图片ID。

上传图片到点播返回的图片唯一标识。
description.en:
The ID of the image.

This ID is returned after you upload the image to ApsaraVideo VOD.

description.zh:
AI模板ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 调用[添加AI模板](~~102930~~)接口添加AI模板时，AI模板ID为返回参数TemplateId的值。
- AI模板添加后，可调用[查询AI模板列表](~~102936~~)接口查询AI模板ID，为请求后返回参数TemplateId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the AI template. You can obtain the ID in one of the following ways:

- Call the [Add AI template](~~102930~~) operation. The template ID is returned as TemplateId in the response.

- Call the [Query AI template list](~~102936~~) operation. The template ID is returned as TemplateId in the response.

title.zh: 提交图片智能审核作业

descriptions.zh:
- **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解视频点播产品的收费方式和价格。智能审核为付费功能，计费详情，<props="china">请参见[智能审核计费](~~188310#section-g7l-s3o-9ng~~)。</props><props="intl">请提交工单或联系阿里云商务经理了解。</props>**
- <props="china">本接口目前仅支持**上海、北京、新加坡地域**。</props><props="intl">本接口仅支持新加坡地域。</props>
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027551~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询智能审核作业](~~454959~~)主动查询任务状态。
- 单个图片大小不超过20 MB，高度或宽度不超过30000px，且图片总像素不超过2.5亿px。
- （建议）图片像素不低于256×256px，像素过低可能会影响审核效果。
descriptions.en:
- **Intelligent media moderation is a paid service. Before you call this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and pricing of ApsaraVideo VOD. <props="china">For more information, see [Billing of intelligent media moderation](~~188310#section-g7l-s3o-9ng~~).</props><props="intl">To learn more, submit a ticket or contact your Alibaba Cloud account manager.</props>**

<props="china">

- This operation is available only in the **China (Shanghai), China (Beijing), and Singapore** regions.

</props><props="intl">This operation is available only in the Singapore region.</props>

- This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027551~~). After a task is submitted, the system returns a job ID and queues the job for asynchronous processing. The job is not complete when the initial response is returned. The final result is delivered through a [callback](~~454959~~). You can also call the [Query intelligent media moderation jobs](~~454959~~) operation to check the task status.

- An image cannot exceed 20 MB in size. Its height or width cannot exceed 30,000 pixels, and the total number of pixels cannot exceed 250 million.

- (Recommended) For best results, use an image with a resolution of at least 256 × 256 pixels. A lower resolution may affect the moderation accuracy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod submit-ai-image-audit-job --media-id f1aa3024aee64000006dc8ca20dbc320 --template-id a07a7f7d7d10eb9fd999e56ecc0000 --media-audit-configuration ResourceType_:_0000_short_video --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vod SubmitAIImageAuditJob --region cn-hangzhou --MediaId f1aa3024aee64000006dc8ca20dbc320 --MediaAuditConfiguration 'ResourceType_:_0000_short_video' --TemplateId a07a7f7d7d10eb9fd999e56ecc0000
